engine: Flutter; Dart Canvas paths/gradients and native widgets on iOS/Android

runtime_asset_mapping.producers: Original declarative geometry compiled into producer_art_data.dart; no runtime SVG rasterization.
runtime_asset_mapping.harbor: Direct HarborArt Canvas painter; scene descriptors/PNG samples are review artifacts.
runtime_asset_mapping.text: Native widgets and bundled gameplay JSON; no text baked into visual assets.
runtime_asset_mapping.audio: AAC files in mobile assets/audio through audioplayers; soundtrack ZIP excluded from initial install.

source_package_observation.note: Source-file observation, not installed/compressed package size or resident CPU/GPU memory.

texture_pipeline: No custom raster visual files or atlases declared by current pubspec; alpha/color are Canvas operations. Original atlas limits remain applicable if this changes. Canvas/engine/font textures still consume memory.
qualification_limits: Candidate152 iPhone samples and earlier explicitly pinned d85 Android/iPad are evidence for those versions only. Current full host/native integration and minimum physical-device budgets remain open.
remaining_original_requirements: both current native targets plus minimum physical device qualification
full phone/tablet text and accessibility/variant matrix
measured GPU/resident texture and performance budgets
